title: LangChain Open-SWE — Open-source asynchronous coding agent

discoveries.pattern: 3 deterministic middleware hooks wrapping agent LLM loop (message queue injection, automatic PR creation backstop, tool error handling) — ensures safety-critical operations execute regardless of LLM behavior
Slack/Linear/GitHub invocation with deterministic thread ID routing to running agent instances — enables real-time follow-up messaging during task execution
Open-source replication of Stripe Minions / Ramp Inspect / Coinbase Cloudbot architecture — channel invocation → sandbox isolation → automatic PR creation → thread notifications
Intentional limitation to ~15 tools following 'tool curation matters more than tool quantity' — includes fetch_url and http_request as additions to standard file/shell tools
Pluggable cloud sandbox providers (Modal/Daytona/Runloop/LangSmith) with per-task isolation, persistence across follow-ups, and auto-recreation on failure

key_takeaway: Open SWE is LangChain's productized enterprise coding agent — the open-source version of Stripe Minions. Its 3-middleware deterministic safety net wrapping the LLM loop is the cleanest implementation of the 70/30 principle. Multi-channel invocation with thread routing is the reference design for Phase 3 client-facing triggers. Study patterns; don't adopt Python/LangChain stack.
